quests.name: Win a Game
quests.desc: Win a single ranked or tournament match.
quests.how: Win one ranked or tournament match against a real opponent. Custom games, solo play, and matches against a bot don't count.

quests.name: Win 3 Games
quests.desc: Win three ranked or tournament matches today.
quests.how: Win three ranked or tournament matches against real opponents today; they don't need to be consecutive. Custom, solo, and bot matches don't count.

quests.name: Win 10 Games
quests.desc: Win ten ranked or tournament matches today.
quests.how: A full-session grind: win ten ranked or tournament matches against real opponents today. Custom, solo, and bot matches don't count.

quests.name: Win a Perfect Game (7–0)
quests.desc: Take all seven categories in one ranked or tournament match.
quests.how: Win a ranked or tournament match 7–0 against a real opponent. Losing or tying even one category breaks the perfect run. Custom, solo, and bot matches don't count.

quests.name: Lose a Game 0–7
quests.desc: Lose every category in one ranked or tournament match.
quests.how: Lose a ranked or tournament match 0–7 against a real opponent — a consolation reward for a total wipeout. Custom, solo, and bot matches don't count.

quests.name: Win a Money Game
quests.desc: Win a ranked or tournament match picking only money categories.
quests.how: As the picker in a ranked or tournament match against a real opponent, choose at least 2 categories and make EVERY one of your picks a money stat, then win. Categories your opponent picks don't count. Custom, solo, and bot matches don't count.

quests.name: Win a Time Game
quests.desc: Win a ranked or tournament match picking only time categories.
quests.how: As the picker in a ranked or tournament match against a real opponent, choose at least 2 categories and make EVERY one of your picks a time stat, then win. Categories your opponent picks don't count. Custom, solo, and bot matches don't count.
